source: Chapter 740: Depriver
target: Capitulum 740: Depriver

source: Translator: CKtalon
target: Interpretator: CKtalon

source: “Glutton?” Lumian said approvingly, “Quite the image.”
target: «Gulosus?» inquit Lumian approbans, «Imago praeclara.»

source: Ludwig ignored Lumian’s mockery and continued with the brief introduction, “At this Sequence, hunger truly becomes ingrained in our bodies, allowing us to evolve around it.”
target: Ludwig derisionem Lumiani neglexit et cum brevi introductione pergit: «In hac Sequence, fames vere in corporibus nostris insita fit, quae nos circa eam evolvere sinit.»

source: “What kinds of evolutions are there?” Lumian was concerned that Ludwig would only mention this about Gluttons, just as he had described the Tramp Sequence. Therefore, he took the initiative to inquire.
target: «Quales evolutiones sunt?» Lumian anxius erat ne Ludwig hanc rem solum de Gulosis referret, sicut de Sequence Vagabundi exposuerat. Ergo initium sumens interrogare coepit.

source: Ludwig paused for a few seconds to swallow his food.
target: Ludwig pauca secunda subsistebat ut cibum suum deglutiret.

source: Then, he stuffed a small piece of lemon cake into his mouth and replied in a muffled manner,
target: Tum parvum frustum placentae citreae in os replevit et modo submurmurato respondit:

source: “Internal organs that are better suited for digesting food and absorbing energy. Stronger, more powerful teeth, a bite force and appetite that exceed normal limits…
target: Organa interna, quae melius sunt ad cibum digerendum ac energiam absorbendam; dentes fortiores et potentiores, vis mordendi et appetitus qui limites normales superant…

source: “This will help us obtain different abilities from food more efficiently. We won’t have to worry about being affected by the toxins, viruses, and bacteria that food brings.”
target: Hoc adiuvabit nos ad diversas facultates ex cibo efficacius adipiscendas. Non erimus solliciti ne toxinibus, virus, et bacteriis quae cibus affert, afficiamur.

source: “In other words, even if it’s highly toxic, as long as you consume it with your mouth and treat it as food, you won’t die from the poison?” Lumian suddenly felt that Ludwig would make a suitable assistant for Apothecaries.
target: «Aliis verbis, etsi summopere toxicum sit, dummodo ore utaris et id tamquam cibum habeas, non morieris ex veneno?» Lumian subito sensit Ludovicum fore aptum adiutorem Apothecarum.

source: Ludwig took a sip of milk and shook his head.
target: Ludwig lac suscepit et caput concussit.

source: “We can’t exceed a certain limit. Many Gluttons die from eating random stuff.”
target: «Non possumus certum terminum superare. Multi Gulosi ex fortuito edendo moriuntur.»

source: And you’re not eating random stuff? Lumian scoffed inwardly.
target: «Et tu non edis res fortuitas?» Lumian intus subridens.

source: At the same time, he inwardly sighed.
target: Simul autem intus suspiravit.

source: This guy is quite honest. He’s indeed like a child most of the time. He actually forgot to protest that I had asked additional questions.
target: Hic vir satis honestus est. Vere plerumque puero similis est. Revera oblitus est protestari quod plura quaesiveram.

source: Ludwig set down the milk bottle and picked up a box of cookies.
target: Ludwig deposuit vas lactis et cistam crustularum elexit.

source: Amidst the munching sounds, he continued, “The corresponding Sequence 7 is Gourmet.
target: Inter sonos masticandi, pergit: «Sequencia 7 correspondens est Gourmet.»

source: “At this level, our digestion and eating abilities will improve further. We can discern which ingredients are edible, which are inedible, which ingredients can bring about special effects, and which ingredients need to be combined with others.”
target: «Ad hoc gradu, facultates nostrae digestionis et edendi ulterius meliorabuntur. Possumus discernere quae sint edibilia, quae inedibilia, quae ingredientes effectus speciales efficiant, et quae cum aliis componenda sint.»

source: Lumian thought seriously before asking, “Is extracting the corresponding information from the consumed food one of a Gourmet’s abilities?”
target: Lumian serio meditatus est, antequam rogavit: «Num ex cibo consumpto informationem congruentem extrahere una ex facultatibus Gourmet sit?»

source: This ability had helped Lumian a great deal.
target: Haec facultas Lumiani multum adiuvit.

source: Ludwig, donning a thick yellow cotton nightcap, nodded obediently. “Yes.”
target: Ludwig, indutus crasso pileo nocturni flavi ex lina, oboedienter annuit: «Ita.»

source: He didn’t elaborate on the corresponding abilities.
target: Non de facultatibus correspondentibus amplius disseruit.

source: “Although a Gourmet is useful, I can sense that at this Sequence, you lack sufficient combat strength. Yes, perhaps Tramp will grant you a certain level of street fighting abilities,” Lumian commented from his own perspective.
target: «Etsi Gourmet utilis est, sentio te in hac Sequence vim pugnandi non satis habere. Ita, fortasse Tramp tibi aliquod gradum artes pugnae viaticae conferet,» commentatus est Lumian ex sua sententia.

source: Ludwig didn’t argue, nor did he bother to. How could delicacies already in his mouth or subsequent delicacies be less important than what he was talking about?
target: Ludwig non disputavit, nec curavit. Quomodo deliciae iam in ore ejus aut quae postea venturi essent minus momenti quam ea de quibus loquebatur?

source: He peeled a lollipop and placed it in his mouth, a hint of enjoyment on his face.
target: Ludwig lollipopum exscindit et in os posuit, vultu paulo gaudio tincto.

source: “Beyond that is what you call Sequence 6—Chef.”
target: «Ultra hoc est quod vocatur Sequencia VI—Chef.»

source: “I thought it was Bartender,” Lumian teased.
target: «Putabam eum esse Bartender,» arridebat Lumian.

source: Ludwig pondered seriously and said, “Chefs cover a wider range. It’s not like they can only make cocktails.”
target: Ludwig serio meditatus est et dixit: «Chefi latam varietatem complectuntur; non est, ut solum cocktailas praeparare possint.»

source: Lumian nodded pensively.
target: Lumian pensative annuit.

source: “Is a Chef’s ability to use special ingredients to create mystical dishes, pastries, drinks, and cocktails?”
target: «Num facultas Chef ingrediens speciales ad creandas mysticas cenationes, pastillas, potiones, et cocktailas sit?»

source: Ludwig had displayed this ability numerous times.
target: Ludwig hanc facultatem saepius ostendit.

source: Ludwig couldn’t help but reveal a smug expression.
target: Ludwig vultum superbum revelare non potuit.

source: “That’s right. Every Chef has different characteristics and abilities due to the ingredients they’ve obtained and the food they’ve prepared.
target: «Recte dicis. Unusquisque Chef diversas proprietates et facultates habet ex ingredientibus adeptis et cibis praeparatis.»

source: “Chefs have one thing in common: they have excellent skills in processing ingredients. This includes finding weaknesses and techniques like cutting, chopping, and slicing.”
target: «Chefi unum commune habent: artes praeclarae in tractando ingredientia. Hoc includit reperiendi infirmitates et technicas, ut secandi, concindendi, atque laniandi.»

source: Only at this Sequence would one from the Gourmet pathway truly possess combat strength… However, a Chef is similar to a Contractee. Their actual combat strength depends on their synergy of abilities. The upper limit is very high, and the lower limit is very low… Lumian, thinking of a Contractee, asked curiously, “Is there a limit to the number of permanent effects a Chef can obtain through various mystical foods?”
target: Solum in hac Sequence veram vim pugnandi obtinet aliquis ex via Gourmet… Attamen, Chef similis est Contractee. Vires verae in proelio pendent ex synergia facultatum eorum. Terminus superior valde altus, et inferior valde humilis est… Lumian, de Contractee cogitans, curiose rogavit: «Num terminus sit ad numerum effectuum permanentium quos Chef per varias mysticas cibos adipiscere possit?»

source: As for the negative effects, Lumian, who had eaten Ice Lemon Fish fillet before, had a deep understanding.
target: Quoad effectus negativos, Lumian, qui antea filettum piscium citrei glacialis edisset, profundam intellegentiam habebat.

source: Depending on the ingredients and finished products, mystical dishes or cocktails brought different negative effects, but they were significantly weaker than those a Contractee experienced.
target: Secundum ingredientes et producta perfecta, fercula mystica aut cocktailae effectus negativos diversos afferebant, sed significanter debiliores erant quam illi, quos Contractee expertus est.

source: “No.” Ludwig quickly shook his head. “As long as you fully embrace hunger and greed, there won’t be an upper limit.”
target: «Minime.» Ludwig celeriter caput concussit. «Dummodo fames et avaritiam plene amplectaris, terminus superior non erit.»

source: This upper limit is a little crazy… However, this also means that there’s no limit to the number of negative effects. Even if each one is far inferior to the ones brought about by a Contractee, they will undergo a qualitative change after stacking… Lumian pondered for a moment and looked at Ludwig, who had roughly finished his meal.
target: Hic terminus superior aliquantum insanus est… Attamen hoc etiam significat nullum finem esse ad numerum effectuum negativorum. Etiamsi unusquisque longe inferior erit illis quos Contractee afferre potest, post aggregationem mutationem qualitatem subibit… Lumian paulisper meditatus est et in Ludovicum aspexit, qui fere suum cibum consumpsisset.

source: “That first time we met, when I saw you chowing down on rats, were you just a Glutton or a Gourmet?”
target: «Prima vice cum te vidissem mures vorantes, num solum Gulosus fuisti aut Gourmet?»

source: Ludwig didn’t try to hide anything.
target: Ludwig nihil occultare conatus est.

source: “Gourmet.”
target: «Gourmet.»

source: Indeed, he’d been critiquing the dishes I served him… Lumian pondered for a moment, then said, “Did you recover to Chef status during that Batings Black Insect incident?”
target: Revera, fercula quae ei servivi criticarat… Lumian paulisper meditatus est, deinde dixit: «Recuperavistine statum Chef tempore illius incidentis Insecti Nigri Batings?»

source: Ludwig curtly confirmed it.
target: Ludwig breviter id confirmavit.

source: “I was just short to begin with. Eating a Batings Black Insect was all it took to advance.”
target: «Initio modo caret eram. Manducare Insectum Niger Batings tantum erat ad progrediendum.»

source: “What’s the next Sequence?” Lumian steered the conversation back on track.
target: «Quae est sequens Sequence?» Lumian sermonem iterum in ordinem redigebat.

source: Ludwig dredged up the memories.
target: Ludwig memorias revocavit.

source: “It’s Depriver.”
target: «Est Depriver.»

source: “Depriver?” Lumian immediately thought of the Deprivation Bullet he’d gotten from Jebus.
target: «Depriver?» Lumian statim meminit Teli Deprivationis, quod a Jebus acceperat.

source: Could this be a transaction from the cult of the Gourmet pathway?
target: Num hoc fieri potest commercium ex cultu viae Gourmet?

source: Ludwig thought Lumian wanted him to explain the Depriver’s abilities.
target: Ludwig putavit Lumian eum velle facultates Depriver explicare.

source: He recounted, “A Depriver can strip one to three abilities from a target for a period of time. If they then consume part of the target’s flesh, they permanently gain one of those abilities, and the target permanently loses it unless they drink a potion again or kill me—no, the corresponding Depriver.
target: Narravit: «Depriver potest e obiecto unam ad tres facultates pro certo tempore auferri. Si deinde partem carnis obiecti consumat, permanenter unam ex his facultatibus adipiscitur, et obiectum eam permanentiter amittit, nisi potionem iterum bibat aut Depriver congruus occidatur.»

source: “At Depriver, our recipes get way more range. A ton of formerly inedible things become food. We can consume things we previously couldn’t.”
target: «Ad Depriver, recetas nostras longe ampliamus. Multa, quae olim inedibilia erant, in cibum vertuntur. Possumus edere res quas antea edere non poderamus.»

source: “Give me an example?” Lumian wasn’t sure his interpretation matched Ludwig’s intentions.
target: «Exemplum, quaeso?» Lumian non certo erat an interpretatio eius cum propositis Ludovici concurreret.

source: Ludwig looked at him and offered two examples.
target: Ludwig eum aspexit et duo exempla proposuit.

source: “Corruption to a certain degree, as well as fireballs, lightning, and other energy forms.”
target: «Corruptio ad certum gradum, necnon globuli ignis, fulmina, et aliae formae energiae.»

source: They can eat way more dangerous stuff and consume things that shouldn’t even be considered food… Lumian thought of an enemy he’d faced at the Hostel and something Ludwig just mentioned. He asked for confirmation, “So that ability to process ingredients includes those ingredients too?”
target: Possunt edere res multo periculosa et consumere quidquid cibus esse non debet… Lumian de inimico, quem apud Hostel occurrerat, et de re nuper a Ludovico dicta cogitavit. Confirmare quaesivit: «Itaque illa facultas tractandi ingredientes etiam eos ingredientes includit?»

source: “Yes,” Ludwig admitted candidly.
target: «Ita,» Ludovico pro certo confitebatur.

source: Lumian pulled the matte Deprivation Bullet from his Traveler’s Bag and set it on the dining table.
target: Lumian telum Deprivationis mateum e sacco viatoris extraxit et in mensa posuit.

source: “This is from a Depriver?”
target: «Hoc a Depriver provenit?»

source: Ludwig’s eyes lit up.
target: Oculi Ludovici fulserunt.

source: “Yes.”
target: «Ita.»

source: He said anxiously, “Can I… can I use it as a prize? I don’t want that Beyonder characteristic anymore!”
target: Anxie dixit: «Possumne eam uti tamquam praemium? Illam qualitatem Beyonder amplius nolo!»

source: “I think Beyonder characteristics are way more valuable,” Lumian deliberately provoked him.
target: «Putō enim qualitates Beyonder longe pretiosiores esse,» provocavit Lumian.

source: Ludwig looked sad and said reluctantly, “But I can only choose one.
target: Ludwig tristis aspiciens, haesitans, dixit: «Sed una tantum eligere possum.»

source: “I can’t actually consume Beyonder characteristics yet. I can only use them as ingredients for now.”
target: «Nondum vere qualitates Beyonder consumere possum; solum ut ingredientes adhibere ea possum.»

source: Is that right… Lumian eyed Ludwig and organized his thoughts.
target: Num ita sit… Lumian Ludovicum intuebatur et cogitationes suas ordinabat.

source: “How much more do you need to eat to recover to Depriver?”
target: «Quantum adhuc edendum est, ut ad Depriver recupere possis?»

source: “The further along I go, the harder it gets. I can’t just eat a ton. I need higher quality, higher energy foods.” Ludwig pointed at the Deprivation Bullet. “I’d need at least 200 of these bullets to reach Depriver.”
target: «Quo longius proficio, eo difficilius fit. Non possum tantum in multitudinem edere; mihi opus sunt ciborum altioris qualitatis et energiae.» Ludovigo ad Telum Deprivationis demonstravit. «Saltem ducentos ex his telis ad Depriver pervenire oporteret.»

source: Lumian chuckled and whispered devilishly, “What if you ate the Depriver who made this bullet?”
target: Lumian risu molli et subdolum susurrans dixit: «Quid si Depriver, qui hoc telum fecit, ederes?»

source: “I could recover immediately!” Ludwig’s eyes lit up.
target: «Statim recuperei possem!» Oculi Ludovici fulserunt.

source: Lumian’s smile widened.
target: Risus Lumiani latius factus est.

source: “You don’t seem to have strong offensive abilities. I can help you get the stuff to capture the corresponding Beyonders, but you gotta listen to me and do what I say before I become a demigod. We need to be totally in sync.
target: «Non vides te artes offensivas validas habere. Te adiuvare possum ut res ad capiendum respectivos Beyonder tibi adipiscaris, sed oportet me audire et quod dicturus sim facere, antequam ego semideus fiam. Omnino coniungamur.»

source: “That’s my promise. You gonna hold up your end of the deal?”
target: «Hoc meum promissum est. Tu partem tuam pacti sustinebis?»

source: Ludwig hesitated a moment before reluctantly nodding.
target: Ludwig paulisper dubitavit antequam reluctanter annuit.

source: “Deal.”
target: «Pactum.»

source: Phew, stay calm… This is just the start of the “taming,” not the end. Long process ahead… Lumian suppressed his smile and asked curiously, “Who were you following back then?”
target: Eheu, mane tranquillus… Hoc solum initium est "domandi", non finis. Longum iter ante nos est… Lumian risum suum cohibuit et curiose rogavit: «Quem tunc secutus es?»

source: “No need for the full title. Just call them something like ‘the Great Mother.’”
target: «Non opus est pleno titulo. Illos tantum appellas, ut "Magna Mater."»

source: Ludwig was caught off guard.
target: Ludwig inopinanter comprehensus est.

source: His expression shifted a few times before tears streamed down his face. He wailed like a child.
target: Vultus eius aliquoties mutatus est, antequam lacrimae per faciem eius effluere coeperunt. Velut puer clamavit.

source: “I-I don’t remember!
target: «N–non memini!»

source: “I’ve forgotten. I’ve forgotten everything!”
target: «Oblitus sum. Omnia oblitus sum!»

source: Hearing his cries, Lugano emerged from the guest room in a thick coat.
target: Auditis clamoribus eius, Lugano ex conclavi hospitum in crasso pallio emersit.

source: The Doctor immediately noticed Lumian and asked in confusion, “Why is he crying?”
target: Medicus statim Lumian animadvertit et, confusus, quaesivit: «Cur plorat?»

source: Is this really the terrifying cannibal from the Dream Festival?
target: Num vere hic est terribilis anthropophagus ex Festivitate Somniorum?

source: Lumian chuckled in response.
target: Lumian risu respondit.

source: “I showed him delicacies but didn’t give him any.”
target: «Illi fercula exquisita ostendi, sed nihil dedi.»

source: “Alright…” Lugano looked between them in confusion before retreating back to his room.
target: «Bene...» Lugano inter eos confusus aspexit, deinde ad conclavium suum rediit.

source: Lugano’s brief appearance made Lumian remember an item, and he had a dangerous thought.
target: Brevis apparitio Luganoi Lumiani rem memoriam fecerat, et periculosam cogitationem habuit.

source: He pulled the remains of Omebella’s umbilical cord from his Traveler’s Bag and “consulted” Ludwig, who’d gradually stopped sobbing.
target: Reliquias funiculi umbilicalis Omebellae e sacco viatoris extraxit et Ludwig consultavit, qui paulatim fletum desierat.

source: “What dishes and cocktails could you make with this?”
target: «Quae fercula et cocktailas ex hoc facere potes?»

source: That umbilical cord left behind by the Great Mother’s Child of God was thought to be just an ingredient for charms, mystical items, and Beyonder weapons.
target: Iste funiculus umbilicalis, relicta a Filio Dei Magnae Matris, existimabatur solum esse elementum pro talibus amuletis, rebus mysticis, et armis Beyonder.

source: But now Lumian figured a Gourmet might see it differently.
target: Sed nunc Lumian existimavit Gourmet eam aliter videre posse.

source: Looking at Omebella’s umbilical cord remains, Ludwig licked his lips.
target: Aspiciens reliquias funiculi umbilicalis Omebellae, Ludwig labra sua lambit.

source: “It could make three types of food with different mystical effects.
target: «Ex eo fieri possunt tres genera ciborum cum diversis effectibus mysticis.

source: “One food would completely cure infertility.”
target: «Unum cibus infertilitatis omnino curare posset.»

source: “Don’t need that,” Lumian said in amusement. “What about the other two foods?”
target: «Non opus est hoc,» inquit Lumian hilare, «quid de reliquis duobus cibis?»

source: Ludwig said professionally, “One grants potent self-healing abilities, though inferior to a Vampire’s.
target: Ludwig technicaliter dixit: «Unus facultates potentissimas auto-sanationis praebet, quamquam in potentia inferior ad vampiri.»

source: “And another…”
target: «Et alterum…»
